Build an OpenFOAM icoFoam transient incompressible lid-driven cavity case with the following details.
The cavity is 0.1 m in x, 0.1 m in y, and 0.01 m in z (single cell thick in z).
The mesh is a uniform 20×20×1 Cartesian grid generated with blockMesh.
The blockMeshDict vertices are (0 0 0), (0.1 0 0), (0.1 0.1 0), (0 0.1 0), (0 0 0.01), (0.1 0 0.01), (0.1 0.1 0.01), (0 0.1 0.01).
The block is defined as (0 1 2 3 4 5 6 7) with a single cell in the z-direction.
Boundary patch 'movingWall' is assigned to the top face (y = 0.1) with type 'wall'.
Boundary patch 'fixedWalls' is assigned to the left, right, and bottom faces with type 'wall'.
Boundary patch 'frontAndBack' is assigned to the z-faces with type 'empty'.
In constant/transportProperties, set nu = 0.001.
In 0/U, set the initial value to uniform (0 0 0).
In 0/U, set the 'movingWall' boundary condition to fixedValue uniform (1 0 0).
In 0/U, set the 'fixedWalls' boundary condition to noSlip.
In 0/U, set the 'frontAndBack' boundary condition to empty.
In 0/p, set the initial value to uniform 0.
In 0/p, set the 'movingWall' boundary condition to fixedFluxExtrapolatedPressure.
In 0/p, set the 'fixedWalls' boundary condition to fixedFluxExtrapolatedPressure.
In 0/p, set the 'frontAndBack' boundary condition to empty.
Set one pressure reference cell (e.g., cell 0) to p = 0 using a fixedValue point or referenceCell to anchor the pressure field.
In system/controlDict, set application to icoFoam, startTime 0, endTime 0.5, deltaT 0.002, writeControl adjustable or runTime with writeInterval 50.
In system/fvSchemes, use Euler for ddtSchemes, linear for gradSchemes, Gauss linear for divSchemes, Gauss linear cellPoint for interpolationSchemes, and correctNonOrtho for grad (or standard icoFoam defaults).
In system/fvSolution, use the PIMPLE or simple solver family with Gauss-symmetric or GAMG for pressure and smoothSolver for velocity, consistent with standard icoFoam settings.
